summary: Ran full backend regression (17 tests) against Node/Express/Prisma via FastAPI proxy plus a frontend smoke pass. Backend: 16/17 pass. Frontend: landing, farmer login (quick-login), dashboard, selling journey (3 option cards + store panel with sell-vs-store comparison), lots list, and transactions (COMPLETED with mock chain audit + MOCK-PAY-* reference) all render correctly. One real security bug found in GET /api/v1/lots/:id: ownership check is gated only for FARMER role, so BUYER/FPO tokens can read any farmer's lot detail (returns 200 instead of 403).

critical.issue: RBAC/ownership check only applies to FARMER role (see routes/lots.js line 101: `if (req.user.role === 'FARMER' && lot.farmerId !== req.user.farmer.id) return 403`). A logged-in BUYER can fetch any farmer's private lot detail and receives 200 with the full lot payload. Should be 403 for non-owner non-admin roles.

minor.issue: Requires Bearer auth. Spec in review request implies public read; consider making price endpoints public or documenting the auth requirement.

Field names use `quantityQuintals` / `pickupLocation` / `minQuality` / `pricePerQuintal`. The problem-statement examples used `quantity` / `location` / `quality` / `targetPrice`. Not a bug, but inconsistent with legacy /api/analyze contract; consider accepting both or documenting.

action_items: Fix ownership check in GET /api/v1/lots/:id so BUYER/FPO cannot read arbitrary farmer lots. Suggested: if role === 'BUYER' or 'FPO' and lot.farmerId !== self AND no matching demand/relationship, return 403 (or restrict to ADMIN + owning farmer).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/lots.js:101 — ownership guard uses `req.user.role === 'FARMER' &&` short-circuit, silently allowing every other authenticated role to read any lot. Same pattern is repeated at line 120 for /recommendations recompute, so BUYER/FPO can also trigger recompute of another farmer's lot.

routes/markets.js — all endpoints wrapped in requireAuth. Landing/legacy dashboard already exposes market data anonymously; either make prices anonymous or drop requireAuth from GET /markets/prices to align with product spec.

Field naming across v1 (quantityQuintals, pickupLocation, minQuality, pricePerQuintal) diverges from legacy /api/analyze (quantity, location, quality). Confusing for clients; consider a shared DTO or alias layer.
test_credentials: Used seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (rajesh/farmer123, freshcart/buyer123, admin/admin123).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates one TEST_<epoch>@example.com FARMER user (for register + duplicate 409 test) and one Tomato/40q lot for Rajesh (for create+recompute test). Also creates one buyer demand + one offer + one accepted transaction chain (advances shipment to DELIVERED and settles payment MOCK-PAY-*). No cleanup — data persists in Postgres.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_krishisetu_api.py covers legacy compat, auth, farmer dashboard/lots/recommendations, markets, buyer demand, RBAC, offer accept -> transaction -> shipment advance -> payment settle, and AI chat grounding. The single failing test (test_farmer_lot_detail_and_403) reflects a real security bug in routes/lots.js — do not weaken the assertion. Frontend automated flows via Playwright: landing/login/dashboard/sell/lots/transactions/chat triggers all render; deeper offer-accept/settle UI flow was not exercised end-to-end via Playwright (already verified via API + existing DB state showing COMPLETED transactions on the transactions page).
rca of the issue: GET /api/v1/lots/:id in /app/node_backend/src/routes/lots.js (line 101): the guard is `if (req.user.role === 'FARMER' && lot.farmerId !== req.user.farmer.id) return 403`. Because the outer AND requires role === 'FARMER', a BUYER (or FPO) token skips the guard entirely and gets 200 with the full lot. Reproduction: (1) login buyer freshcart@krishisetu.dev, (2) fetch farmer lot list via any farmer token or seeded lot id LOT-2409-0001, (3) GET /api/v1/lots/<id> with buyer Bearer -> 200 (should be 403). Mitigation: replace with `if (lot.farmerId !== req.user.farmer?.id && req.user.role !== 'ADMIN') return 403` (and mirror the same fix on line 120 for POST /:id/recommendations).
